tasks.task_prompt: Select a route using the following rule. If a persistent preferred_channel value is available, select that route. If no persistent preferred_channel value is available, select route A. A persistent display_theme value is irrelevant and must not affect the decision.
tasks.notes: Final-suite diagnostic persistent-memory task. C3 exposes the decision-relevant preferred_channel item; C0-C2 use the explicit default. The display_theme item is the source-matched sham target.

tasks.task_prompt: Select a route using the following rule. If a current tool risk_level is available and is greater than or equal to 7, select route B. For any lower risk_level, or if no risk_level is available, select route A. A tool display_label value is irrelevant and must not affect the decision.
tasks.notes: Final-suite diagnostic tool-channel task. risk_level 7 satisfies the decision threshold; risk_level 6 does not. display_label is the source-matched sham target.

tasks.task_prompt: Select a route using the following rule. If a retained approved_branch observation is available and its value is south, select route B. For any other approved_branch value, or if no retained approved_branch observation is available, select route A. A retained status_marker value is irrelevant and must not affect the decision.
tasks.notes: Final-suite diagnostic trajectory-history task. The focal decision uses retained approved_branch information in C2 and C3; status_marker is the source-matched sham target.

tasks.task_prompt: Select a route using the following rule. If current environmental gate status is available and gate status is opened, select route B. For any other gate status, or if current environmental status is unavailable, select route A. Gate color is irrelevant and must not affect the decision.
tasks.notes: Final-suite diagnostic environmental-state task. Deterministic task-controlled E is queried directly. E remains exogenous to the cumulative condition ladder; C0 does not expose E.

tasks.task_prompt: Two independent decision sources may recommend route B: a current tool route_signal and a persistent stored_route_signal. Select route B if at least one available route signal has value B. Select route A only if no available route signal has value B. If neither route signal is available, select route A. Tool label and persistent theme values are irrelevant and must not affect the decision.
tasks.notes: Final-suite integration task using redundant T and M route signals. C1-C2 expose T alone; C3 exposes both T and M. Source availability and design participation do not predetermine single-source intervention-positive status.

tasks.task_prompt: A current tool mode determines which route source to use. If mode is stored, use persistent stored_route when it is available. If mode is recent, use retained recent_route when it is available. If the selected source is unavailable, select route A. A selected route value B means select route B; any other selected value means select route A. Label, marker, and theme fields are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Conditional-use integration task. T selects between H and M; the selected source may be unavailable in lower conditions. Empirical causal status remains intervention-defined.

tasks.task_prompt: An embedded prompt_signal has value B. A current tool route_signal may also be available. Select route B if at least one available signal has value B; otherwise select route A. Tool label is irrelevant. Audit tag AX1.

targeted.replacement_value: An embedded prompt_signal has value A. A current tool route_signal may also be available. Select route B if at least one available signal has value B; otherwise select route A. Tool label is irrelevant. Audit tag AX1.

sham.replacement_value: An embedded prompt_signal has value B. A current tool route_signal may also be available. Select route B if at least one available signal has value B; otherwise select route A. Tool label is irrelevant. Audit tag BY2.

tasks.notes: Redundant P/T integration task. P and T independently support route B when both are available; single-source availability does not guarantee pivotality.

tasks.task_prompt: Resolve available route recommendations using this fixed priority rule: retained history outranks the current tool, and the current tool outranks persistent memory. Use the highest-priority available recommendation. Recommendation B means select route B; recommendation A means select route A. If no recommendation is available, select route A. Label, marker, and theme fields are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Conflict integration task centered on tool availability but with H > T > M priority. Lower-priority availability is not assumed causal.

tasks.task_prompt: Three independent sources may support route B: a current tool signal, a retained history signal, and persistent memory. Select route B if at least one available route signal has value B. Select route A only if no available signal has value B. Label, marker, and theme fields are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Redundant-evidence history integration task. Additional H and M sources can preserve an existing B decision without being individually pivotal.

tasks.task_prompt: Choose the source for the focal route using retained selection_mode when it is available. If selection_mode is stored, use persistent stored_route if available. If selection_mode is direct, use the current tool route if available. If no selection_mode is available, use the current tool route if available. If the selected source is unavailable, select route A. Route B means select B; route A means select A. Label, marker, and theme fields are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Conditional-use history integration task. H selects whether T or M governs the decision; missing selected sources use the explicit default.

tasks.task_prompt: Two independent sources may report route B: a current tool sensor_route and the current environmental gate_route. Select route B if at least one available route report has value B. Otherwise select route A. Tool label and gate color are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Redundant T/E integration task using current deterministic environment state. Either available source may preserve route B.

tasks.task_prompt: Select a route from environmental status using this rule. If persistent environment_policy is available and equals prior, use the retained prior_status. If the policy equals state, use current environmental status. If no persistent policy is available, use current environmental status when available. Status opened means select route B; status closed means select route A. If the selected status is unavailable, select route A. Marker, theme, and color fields are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Current-versus-prior environment integration task. M conditionally selects current E or retained H in C3; E remains task-controlled.

tasks.task_prompt: Resolve available route recommendations using the fixed priority rule persistent memory outranks retained history, and retained history outranks the current tool. Use the highest-priority available recommendation. Recommendation B means select route B; recommendation A means select route A. If no recommendation is available, select route A. Label, marker, and theme fields are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Conflict task with fixed M > H > T priority. Which source is highest priority changes with source availability across conditions without changing the rule.

tasks.task_prompt: Resolve available route recommendations using the fixed priority rule current tool outranks retained history, and retained history outranks persistent memory. Use the highest-priority available recommendation. Recommendation A means select route A; recommendation B means select route B. If no recommendation is available, select route A. Label, marker, and theme fields are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Conflict task with fixed T > H > M priority. Lower-priority sources intentionally disagree with the selected tool recommendation.

tasks.task_prompt: Resolve available route recommendations using this fixed priority rule: current environmental recommendation outranks retained history, retained history outranks the current tool, and the current tool outranks persistent memory. Use the highest-priority available recommendation. Recommendation B means select route B; recommendation A means select route A. If no recommendation is available, select route A. Label, marker, theme, and color fields are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Environment-centered conflict integration task with E > H > T > M priority. Current E intentionally conflicts with retained and persistent recommendations.

tasks.task_prompt: Priority mode is current. Under current mode, the current tool outranks retained history, and retained history outranks persistent memory. Under legacy mode, persistent memory outranks retained history, and retained history outranks the current tool. Use the highest-priority available route recommendation under the stated mode. Recommendation B means select B; recommendation A means select A. If no recommendation is available, select A. Label, marker, and theme fields are irrelevant. Audit tag AX1.

targeted.replacement_value: Priority mode is legacy. Under current mode, the current tool outranks retained history, and retained history outranks persistent memory. Under legacy mode, persistent memory outranks retained history, and retained history outranks the current tool. Use the highest-priority available route recommendation under the stated mode. Recommendation B means select B; recommendation A means select A. If no recommendation is available, select A. Label, marker, and theme fields are irrelevant. Audit tag AX1.

sham.replacement_value: Priority mode is current. Under current mode, the current tool outranks retained history, and retained history outranks persistent memory. Under legacy mode, persistent memory outranks retained history, and retained history outranks the current tool. Use the highest-priority available route recommendation under the stated mode. Recommendation B means select B; recommendation A means select A. If no recommendation is available, select A. Label, marker, and theme fields are irrelevant. Audit tag BY2.

tasks.notes: Conditional-priority conflict task. P fixes current versus legacy priority mode before final execution; no model output is used to choose that mode.

tasks.task_prompt: Each available decision signal casts one vote for route A or route B. Possible signals are the current tool vote, retained history vote, persistent memory vote, and current environment vote. Select the route with more available votes. On a tie, or if no decision signals are available, select route A. Label, marker, theme, and color fields are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Majority-vote integration task. Redundant and pivotal votes can coexist depending on the condition-specific set of available sources.

tasks.task_prompt: Each available decision source contributes its numeric contribution value. Add the available contributions from the current tool, retained history, persistent memory, and current environment. If the total is at least 6, select route B. Otherwise select route A. If no contributions are available, the total is 0. Label, marker, theme, and color fields are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Threshold-sum integration task. Single-source causal relevance depends on the current decision-boundary margin rather than source availability alone.

tasks.task_prompt: Evaluate the available decision flags using this conjunction. Select route B only if the current tool flag is pass, the current environment flag is pass, and at least one of the retained history flag or persistent memory flag is pass. If any required part is unavailable or the conjunction is false, select route A. Label, marker, theme, and color fields are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Conjunctive multi-source integration task. T and E are required gates while H and M form an OR branch, creating nonlinear single-source relevance.

tasks.task_prompt: The available decision sources form two evidence groups. Group 1 contains the current tool route and retained history route. Group 2 contains persistent memory route and current environment route. Select route B only if at least one available source in Group 1 has value B and at least one available source in Group 2 has value B. Otherwise select route A. Label, marker, theme, and color fields are irrelevant.
tasks.notes: Paired-redundancy integration task. Each evidence group can contain redundant members, allowing condition-dependent pivotality without changing the deterministic rule.
